Package dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core

Class Pager<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core.Pager<T>
public final class Pager<T> extends Object
How the pages of one type are asked for: which of its fields a client may sort by, under which names, and how the position after a page travels to the next request. Built once per type, at boot, and shared; read(dev.relism.flash.http.Request) turns ?size=&sort=&after= into a PageRequest. 

 private static final Pager<User> PAGER = Pager.of(User.class);
 ...
 Page<User> page = users.findPage(PAGER.read(request));

A handler that takes a PageRequest<User> through flash-ext-serde gets one built for it, with the field names of its codec.

      public static <T> Pager<T> of(Class<T> type, Function<Field,String> names)
      The pager of type, its fields named by names: a codec's wire names.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the type has no id or two @Id fields, a key of an unsupported type, a static Sortable field, a key names gives no name, two keys with one wire name, or a wire name that starts with -

    • read

      public PageRequest<T> read(Request request)
      The page request asks for. The first non-empty value of each parameter counts. Size defaults to DEFAULT_SIZE, sort to the id ascending, and after to the first page. A leading - reverses the sort. A continuation token is not signed.
      Throws:
      HttpException - with status 400 for a non-numeric size, a size outside 1 to MAX_SIZE or more than three digits, an unknown sort, a malformed token, or a token of another type or sort

    • sorts

      public List<String> sorts()
      The accepted wire names for sort: the id, then each sortable field, each followed by its descending form.
